QuestInfo.name: Materials for a Special Marble
QuestInfo.0: #p204# of #m10001000# seems to be worrying a great deal over #p218#'s birthday present.
QuestInfo.1: It looks like #p204# has decided to make a prettier, sturdier marble for #b#p218##k. For #p204#'s sake, let's head down into the #b#m10003000# subway#k or the depths of the Ant Tunnel, defeat some #b#o33##k or #b#o34##k, and gather #b#t4000029##k. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I brought #p204# the item she asked for. Still, no matter how I look at it, it really seems like #p218# is just trying to mess with #p204#.

0.0: There's only one #t4031008#, and it was already such a precious thing to me — I already gave it to #p225# as a birthday present, and now #p218# wants that very same thing... Whatever should I do?
0.1: Hmm... I suppose I'll just have to make a special marble for #p218#. If I make one that's even prettier and sturdier than the one I gave #p225#, I'm sure #p218# will be pleased with it too. So, I was wondering... could you help me out just once more?

yes.0: Thank you so much! For a pretty, sturdy marble, I think #t4000029# would work best. It has such a unique pattern and is quite sturdy, so it should hold up well even with someone as careless as #p218#. You should be able to get #b#t4000029##k from #b#o33##k or #b#o34##k, deep within the #m10003000# subway or the Ant Tunnel. I'm counting on you!

no.0: You seem to be busy right now. There isn't much time left before #p218#'s birthday, so I'm not sure what to do...

1.0: Oh, you're back! Let's see... you've brought so many #t4000029#s in such good condition...! Thank you so much! Thanks to you, I should be able to make just the right marble for #p218#. Would you mind waiting just a little while longer?

item.0: Please gather #b#t4000029##k from #b#o33##k or #b#o34##k, deep within the #m10003000# subway or the Ant Tunnel. In the meantime, I'll get everything ready to make the marble.
